after.rosterkit/contacts.py:
# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by name and aligned in columns."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(f"no email for {student.display_name}")
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    name_width = max(len(student.display_name) for student in ordered)
    section_width = max(len(student.section) for student in ordered)
    return [
        f"{student.display_name:<{name_width}}  {student.section:<{section_width}}  {student.email}"
        for student in ordered
    ]
after.tests/test_contacts.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            Student("2", "Zed", "Amy", "B2", "amy@example.com"),
            Student("1", "Adams", "Bo", "A10", "bo@example.com")
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, [
            "Adams, Bo  A10  bo@example.com",
            "Zed, Amy   B2   amy@example.com"
        ])

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([Student("1", "Adams", "Bo", "A10")])
        self.assertIn("Adams, Bo", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
